question: Which organism among the following breaks down the food material outside the body and then absorbs it?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Yeast.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The essential nutrients needed for bodies are gathered from dead and decaying debris in the saprotrophic mode of diet.
 
• **Rhizopus, yeast, and mushrooms are saprotrophic organisms.**
 
• Organisms that are saprophytes are unable to produce their own food.
 
• **Yeast** is a single-celled microorganism that belongs to the Kingdom of Fungi along with molds and mushrooms.
 
• Yeasts are divided into two distinct phyla, Ascomycota or sac fungi, and Basidiomycota or higher fungi, which together make up the subkingdom Dikarya due to their evolutionary diversity.
 
• They are **frequently discovered in soil, as well as on the leaves, flowers, and fruits of plants.**
 
• Yeast can live symbiotically or as parasites in the intestinal tracts of warm-blooded mammals as well as on the skin's surface.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ticks:**

 
 
• Ticks are parasites that feed by biting their warm-blooded hosts. 
 
• A tick bite can infect humans and animals with bacteria, viruses and protozoans (organisms made up of one cell) that can cause diseases.
 
• Some of these conditions can be very serious and may include: Lyme disease, Tularemia, Ehrlichiosis, Rocky Mountain spotted fever, Anaplasmosis and Babesiosis.
 
 
 
• **Leeches:**
 
 
• Leeches are annelids or segmented worms, and although closely related to the earthworms, are anatomically and behaviourally more specialised.
 
 
 
• **Lice:**
 
 
• Lice are tiny, wingless, parasitic insects that feed on human blood. Lice are easily spread through close personal contact and by sharing belongings.
